title: "F-PRG — Pseudorandom generator"
status: "Open"
layer: 2
definition: "Not yet written"
---

*F-PRG* (Pseudorandom generator) is part of *Cryptographic Library and Symmetric Primitives* in the UC functionality encyclopedia. Status: open — no accepted UC formulation exists yet.

This is one of several purely local, hardness-based primitives (alongside *F-OWF*, *F-CRHF*, and *F-MHF*) with no cross-party interface to idealize — the UC composition theorem gives nothing here that a standard hybrid argument doesn't already provide. It's included in this encyclopedia only to record that absence explicitly.
